query: Start the news item for MD-1820 — it's a Cluster: ticket with a Confluence draft linked in the description.
expected_behavior: Runs the marketing-pages repo guard (content.sh check-repo) and refuses to write unless the checkout is marketing-pages
Reads the Jira ticket, extracts the Confluence inline-card URL and target keywords, and derives the slug from the summary minus the Cluster: prefix
Fetches the Confluence draft and its referenced images, then delegates the storage-format to markdown transform to a Sonnet subagent
Converts and uploads images to ImageKit (blog-featured/<slug>.webp and blog-posts/<slug>/) and writes content/resources/news/<slug>.md with correct front matter
Verifies internal links resolve, checks the served HTML on this worktree's dev server, and cleans up the /tmp working dir
